sections.Profile:
The "Steeple-Chase" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company in October 1957, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin. The machine features two flippers, three pop bumpers, five passive bumpers, two slingshots, six standup targets, and two gobble holes.
